integrity.novelty_scope: Exact analytic p=5 two-copy optimum and optimizer uniqueness at the qutrit Werner--Holevo endpoint; no priority claim for the existence of the p=5 violation or the plotted maximizer.
integrity.proof_dependency: Schmidt reduction, exact output eigenvalue decomposition, Newton identities, Maclaurin inequality, and a one-variable polynomial factorization.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly two copies of the qutrit Werner--Holevo endpoint and Schatten exponent 5.
It does not determine the exact noninteger optimizer-transition exponent, higher-copy behavior, other dimensions, or interior transpose-depolarizing parameters.

The 2002 defining paper already asserted the p=5 maximizer from plots; the new content is the analytic global proof, uniqueness at the Schmidt-spectrum level, exact maximum, and exact violation factor.
A residual literature risk remains for poorly indexed notes or theses containing an equivalent exact derivation.
title: Exact two-copy Schatten-\(5\) optimizer at the Werner--Holevo endpoint
